mapper.update: UPDATE APP_SUBJECT SET SUBJECT_ORDER = #{order} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT text.ID,text.PIC_BINARY picBinary, text.TEXT_NAME textName, text.TEXT_DESC textDesc, text.ENCLOSURE enclosure, text.ENCLOSURE_NAME enclosureName FROM APP_CONTENT_TEXT text LEFT JOIN APP_SUBJECT_CONTENT_TEXT con ON text.ID = con.CONTENT_TEXT_ID WHERE con.SUBJECT_ID = #{id}

SELECT text.ID, text.TEXT_NAME textName, text.ENCLOSURE_NAME enclosureName,DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(text.PIC_BINARY) as picLength FROM APP_CONTENT_TEXT text LEFT JOIN APP_SUBJECT_CONTENT_TEXT con ON text.ID = con.CONTENT_TEXT_ID WHERE con.SUBJECT_ID = #{id}

select subject.ID, asct.CONTENT_TEXT_ID,subject.SUBJECT_NAME,subject.CREATE_TIME, act.TEXT_DESC from APP_SUBJECT subject left join APP_SUBJECT_CONTENT_TEXT asct on subject.ID=asct.SUBJECT_ID left join APP_CONTENT_TEXT act on asct.CONTENT_TEXT_ID=act.ID
and subject.ID = #{query}
